OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When
            supplied it must be a valid postcode for the city's region using a fixed table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it is used to derive
            the owner's 'ageBand', computed against the registrationDate. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. When true, allow creating this owner even though another

          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.

              title: Pets

              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

          items:

        - type

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility, but the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are preferred
            when present. On output it is the composed address — the normalized 'addressLine1' with
            a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when present; a non-blank value satisfies the address requirement. Normalized
            (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded) on create.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address. Normalized like
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When
            supplied it must be a valid postcode for the city's region using a fixed table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it is used to derive
            the owner's 'ageBand', computed against the registrationDate. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. When true, allow creating this owner even though another
            owner already has the same last name and address (same household). Never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans, derived at read time as
                the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes from the left.
                The raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded
                sequence equal to one more than the number of owners at the time this owner was created.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                customerCode. Non-digit characters (such as the separators) are ignored.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household (same last name
                and address). Assigned when an owner joins an existing household via
                'sharesHousehold'; all owners in that household share the same value. Absent for an
                owner that does not share a household.
              type: string
              example: H-3A7F1C0D9E2B
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created, before
                this owner itself was added.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, fixed at creation. Start at 0 and accumulate
                2 when the owner has an email address on record, 1 when the owner had no namesakes at
                creation (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more members, and 3 when the
                owner's tenure exceeds 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints; 1 for
                0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived at read time from the city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD). 'UNKNOWN'
                when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone, derived at read time from the locality/region
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is 'UNKNOWN'.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day at the time this owner was created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time. 'EMAIL' when
                the owner has an email address on record, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, the single value all duplicate detection
                is based on. Formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' +
                (householdId or empty). A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when a new owner's
                whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because the telephone is part of the
                key, two members of the same household with different telephones have different keys
                and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||H-3A7F1C0D9E2B'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from birthDate against the
                registrationDate. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65
                or older. Absent when no birthDate is on record.
              type: string
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shared an existing
                owner's lastName and postcode (with a different telephone) at the time it was
                created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of. Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 42
              readOnly: true

## Summary

I added a structured address form to the create-owner flow while keeping the flat `address` input fully backward-compatible.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** (`OwnerFields` schema) — added `addressLine1` and `addressLine2` (optional), documented `address` as the composed output, and removed `address` from the `required` list (so a structured owner without a flat `address` still validates against the contract). This regenerates the DTOs used for request binding and the response.

2. **`Owner.java`** (model) — added `addressLine1` / `addressLine2` columns with getters/setters. MapStruct maps them by name in both directions automatically.

3. **DB schemas** (`h2`, `hsqldb`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added `address_line1` / `address_line2` columns to the `owners` table.

4. **`ValidateOwnerFields.normalizeAddress`** — the core logic:
   - When `addressLine1` normalizes to non-blank, it's the **structured form**: both lines are normalized (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand `ST→STREET` etc.), and the flat `address` is set to the composed value — normalized `addressLine1`, plus a single space and normalized `addressLine2` when present.
   - Otherwise it's the **flat form**: the flat `address` is normalized and the structured lines are cleared.
   - Because this runs before the existing blank check on `address`, an owner supplying neither form yields a blank composed `address` → 400 (`Cp01`).

The household hash, postcode validation, and locality already key off `postcode`/`city`, which are shared across both forms, so those behaviors (verified by `Cp29`/`Cp30`/`Cp36`) required no change. The PUT path was left as-is since the change is scoped to create.
